text: {"lessons":["I should not let reluctance to admit a purchase was mistaken keep me from reassessing a position; my original cost is not a reason to hold.","These price moves are random, so recent gains or losses do not reliably predict what comes next; I should avoid reacting to them as signals.","I made no trades as the account fell, so I should review whether my allocation and risk still suit me rather than assume that doing nothing is always prudent."]}
